source.publisher: Daegu IJSO 2015 organizer booklet, preserved by Science Olympiad Foundation Uganda

scope: Cover, complete shared instructions including calculator examples, shared introduction, and all Experiment I pages, including background, equipment, procedure and 14-point question page.
archived_edition_note: The question booklet and separately archived blank answer sheet use different item numbers and point allocations. Both original editions retain their own numbers. The English archive has no displayed rule 9 and the final words of rule 10 end mid-phrase.
